text:
product-ana: Quick announce — we just released the "Community Maintainers Workshop Kit" v0.0.1 :sparkles: (guides, slide deck, and a reproducible demo repo). Link: https://github.com/redwood/maintainers-workshop/releases/tag/v0.0.1
product-ana: Goal is to help partner teams run 45-min workshops for new maintainers with a ready agenda and slides. saves prep time and standardizes expectations.
devrel-kai: huge win. added a tiny facilitator checklist and speaker notes under docs/facilitator.md
ci-bot: CI: artifacts published and tag `v0.0.1` created for redwood/maintainers-workshop 44d All checks passed
security-liz: quick ask: can we add a short slide about scanning/credential hygiene? i'll propose 2 slides and a one-liner policy snippet
product-ana: @security-liz yes please. PRs welcome, or ping me and i'll add them before the community drop next week.
community-jay: i'll schedule a pilot session with external maintainers next Tue 4pm PT and include the facilitator notes. will capture feedback in the repo issue tracker `workshop-feedback`.
devrel-kai: snippet for local demo included in release notes:
```
# quick demo
git clone https://github.com/redwood/maintainers-workshop.git
cd maintainers-workshop/demo
pnpm install
pnpm run demo
# open http://localhost:4000 to run the workshop sandbox
```
product-ana: We'll run an internal dry-run tomorrow 9:30am PT in #devrel-qa — all welcome to join and try the flow.
community-jay: i'll draft a short community blog blurb and social post after the pilot.
product-ana: Thanks everyone — massive thanks to contributors @taylor-m and @open-help for iterating on the deck. We'll track improvements under issues labeled `workshop-improvements`. :rocket:
